jobs.occupation: Sales, Administration and Marketing Apprentice (2-Year Program)
jobs.description:
Automobility-X is a growing company based in Ikast, Denmark, specializing in mobility and vehicle solutions. We work with customers and suppliers across Europe and beyond, giving you the opportunity to gain valuable international experience. As part of our small team, you will work across different areas of the business and take on real responsibility from day one.

We are looking for a motivated and proactive Sales, Administration and Marketing Apprentice who is eager to develop practical skills in sales, administration, marketing, and international trade.

About the apprenticeship

This is a full-time, 2-year apprenticeship (approximately 37 hours per week). During the program, you will receive thorough training and work closely with experienced colleagues who will support your development.

You will be involved in the company's daily operations, communicate with customers and suppliers from around the world, and gain practical experience in an international business environment. For the right candidate, the apprenticeship may lead to a permanent position after completion.

Your responsibilities

• Preparing and following up on quotations 

• Processing customer orders and coordinating deliveries 

• Communicating with customers and suppliers 

• Administrative tasks and invoicing 

• Supporting marketing activities and social media 

• Maintaining product documentation and internal systems 

• Assisting with various ad hoc tasks 

We are looking for someone who

• Is positive, motivated, and enjoys working with people 

• Has an interest in sales, administration, and business 

• Is well organized and takes responsibility for their work 

• Enjoys working in a team and communicating with customers 

• Can manage several tasks in a fast-paced environment 

• Has good English skills (an additional language is an advantage) 

• Is familiar with Microsoft Office 

• Is eager to learn and ready to take on new challenges 

What we offer

• A varied and exciting 2-year apprenticeship 

• Responsibility from the beginning and the opportunity to make an impact 

• An international working environment with customers and suppliers worldwide 

• Close collaboration with experienced colleagues 

• Professional and personal development throughout the apprenticeship 

• Hands-on experience in sales, administration, marketing, logistics, and international trade 

• The possibility of permanent employment after successfully completing the apprenticeship 

Location: Automobility-X ApS, Thrigesvej 37E, 7430 Ikast, Denmark

Start date: By agreement

How to apply:

Please send your CV and a short motivational letter in English or Danish to zofie@am-x.dk. We would like to learn more about you, why you are interested in joining Automobility-X, and what motivates you.

We value genuine, personal applications over generic or AI-generated submissions.

Questions?

If you have any questions about the apprenticeship or the application process, please contact:

Zofie Jarosova, Operations Manager zofie@am-x.dk, +45 5239 344

PEAK Wind is looking for a Cyber Security Consultant, who wants to take their cyber security career to the next level and is looking to work on a diverse and exciting portfolio within wind power and other renewable Energy sources.

Trusted Advisors for Developers and Investors for some of the Largest Renewable Assets
At PEAK Wind, we specialise in operations, asset management, and project management of Renewable Energy assets and take pride in providing best-in-class commercial, financial, and operational advisory and support to our clients. We work with some of the world’s largest infrastructure investments and are proud to count market-leading utilities, investment funds, and independent power producers among our clients.

Job Content, Responsibilities, and Possibilities:
Based in one of our offices in Denmark (Aarhus and Copenhagen), or Germany (Hamburg) you will be working in a team supporting customer projects and programs within the field of IT/OT and cyber security. We are a dedicated team of mixed seniorities and nationalities with a collaborative working environment. SCADA and Cyber Security is a crucial area for our clients, who we support on both greenfield and brownfield projects. The team works across disciplines, ensuring seamless integration, operation, and cyber security of OT, ICS, and SCADA systems.

Your responsibilities include:

- Leading risk assessments of IT/OT environments for clients across large-scale renewable assets, and providing risk mitigation strategies and recommendations.
- Developing IT/OT operating models, guidelines, and procedures for renewable assets.
- Developing and communicating IT/OT infrastructure designs to our customers.
- Implementing cyber security solutions for IT and OT environments on large-scale renewable assets, and reporting to project management, customers directly, and/or other senior engineering functions.
- Adapt to legislation and regulatory requirements for the IT/OT environment. Advise on the utilisation of best practices, policies, and standards, such as IEC62443, and ISO27000.

We expect that you have a minimum of 2-4 years of experience from a similar position, and previous experience with cyber security functions, such as Risk Management, Vulnerability Assessments, and Security Assessments. Furthermore, experience within security systems including firewalls and security engineering is required. Recognized security certification is desirable and experience with implementation of national standards such as NERC/CIP or NIS2 would be considered an advantage. The ideal candidate would have experience with renewable energy projects and/or implementation of Cyber Security Management Systems in other industries.

As a person, you are a team player, and you thrive working in an international and diverse team with mixed cultures and seniorities. You are detail-oriented and possess strong problem-solving skills in IT/OT systems. As PEAK Wind is a global company, you must also have strong English communication skills, both oral and written. Finally, we are looking for a candidate with excellent stakeholder management skills.

Experience the Highest Degree of Involvement
PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity and our values of Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity are materialized through our team members every day. Here you will be able to utilize your financial skills while developing a strong understanding of renewable energy assets. We offer an opportunity to get on board and experience the highest degree of involvement and responsibility in PEAK Wind’s global renewable energy team. Together with the rest of the team, you will play an instrumental part in the continued success of PEAK Wind. Above that, you will participate in an entrepreneurial environment, with a focus on cooperation and a desire to change the status quo. The position will also offer global exposure as our clients work globally.

Core mission: 
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.

Cryogenic fluids are at the heart of our activities: without them, it would not be possible to conduct experiments at very low temperatures and high magnetic fields. We are looking for a technician who will be responsible for cryogenic fluid distribution and helium recovery - an activity with scientific, economic and environmental implications. The technician will also help to design our future cryogenic systems.

Your tasks:
You will join the team of the Services for Advanced Neutron Environments, where you will be responsible for cryogenic fluid distribution and helium recovery. In this role, you will:
- Perform regular checks to ensure that the distribution and recovery systems are working properly.
- Perform maintenance and regulatory requalification of equipment, and upgrade measurement electronics.
- Produce monthly reports on helium consumption and recovery.
- You will also participate, from time to time, in the design and construction of cryogenic systems.

Your profile:
- You have a Level 5 qualification (NVQ, BTEC HNC/HND, foundation degree or equivalent) in physical measurements.
- You are proficient in the use of spreadsheets and web applications, as well as embedded electronics, and have some knowledge of mechanical engineering.
- You are a strong team player with an inquiring mind and a meticulous approach to your work. A service-oriented attitude and strong interpersonal skills would be highly appreciated.
- You are interested in developing unique devices, are keen to work in a multicultural environment, and enjoy tackling technical challenges.
- You are proficient in English, the working language in our international environment.

What we offer: 
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online - preferably in English - via our career portal by 01/11/2026, quoting reference number 26/43. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness (including for work under ionising radiation) is required. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for fundamental research using neutrons. United by our passion for progress and technology, we drive science and research forward every day. Together, we can pave the way for discoveries that will help to make our world a better place.

jobs.occupation: Nuclear Quality Assurance Engineer, INB - French basic nuclear installation
jobs.description:
Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.

The ILL's Quality, Risk Management and Nuclear Safety Unit (CQSR - Cellule Qualité Sûreté Risques) is a small, dynamic team of five people which reports directly to ILL Management. The core mission of the CQSR is to maintain and improve the ILL's Integrated Management System (IMS), which enables the Institute to comply with regulatory requirements for basic nuclear installations (INB - Installation nucléaire de base). This includes aspects relating to nuclear safety and quality management.

Your tasks:
As quality assurance engineer, you will play an active part in the development and maintenance of the IMS. Your main duties will be to:
- Manage the process for monitoring fulfilment of commitments (improvement actions)
- Manage the process for monitoring regulatory changes and compliance
- Propose solutions to help process managers maintain and improve their processes
- Support engineers and technicians with the documentation requirements associated with technical projects to upgrade the facility
- Participate in IMS process reviews
- Help to lead training sessions on the IMS
- Prepare and conduct internal and external quality audits (including field work) on IMS processes

Once you have received training:
- Take on the role of contact person for corruption prevention and fraud control officer (information gathering, awareness-raising, whistleblowing contact person)
- Perform event analyses from an HOF perspective
- Assist with the preparation of the periodic information campaign on industrial hazards

Your profile:
- Master's degree (or equivalent) in quality assurance or Master's degree in general engineering with proven experience in quality assurance.
- Solid professional experience is required.

The ILL is an international research facility at the forefront of neutron science and technology. Its High-Flux Nuclear Reactor delivers the world's most intense neutron beams to a suite of over 40 scientific instruments. Every year, some 1800 international researchers visit the ILL to carry out cutting-edge experiments across a range of scientific disciplines, driving innovation in the fields of health, energy, the environment and quantum materials. The ILL is also involved in the production of radioisotopes for medical applications. The ILL employs over 500 staff from 25 different countries, in a diversity of careers and a multicultural and inclusive environment.

The Science Division at ILL brings together close to 200 scientists, engineers, and technicians who work collaboratively to provide users with advanced experimental capabilities and expert scientific support. The DS is responsible by operating world-class neutron scattering instruments, supporting an international user community, conducting cutting-edge research, and developing new experimental techniques. In addition, the division drives the development of next-generation instrumentation and computational tools, fosters international collaborations, and contributes to advanced training.

-    Performing precision machining of simple mechanical parts (lathing, milling, drilling) at short notice
